articles.title: Ontario premier slams Trump's executive order to rename Lake Ontario as Seneca Nation calls for reversal - CBS News
articles.description: Amid an ongoing trade war​ between Canada and the United States, President Trump last week sought to rename Lake Ontario "Lake America" by executive order.
